//pages: The hand-written HTML pages. references and markup read each of them; a page left out here is published unchecked.
//licensedFontPattern: Any font binary under assets/, not just MonoLisa's woff2. Nok.otf and Nok.ttf sat in assets/ for months because the pattern named one directory and one format; a commercial face is a commercial face wherever it lands. A genuinely free font is the exception and has to be argued for here.
//sitemapPages: The pages sitemap.xml has to advertise, as repo paths; index.html is the root URL and any other page is advertised without its .html, the way the Worker serves it (pagePath in lib/site.mjs). robots.txt names the sitemap as the crawl entry point and llms-full.txt is linked from nowhere else on the site, so a surface left out of this list is published and undiscoverable at once. robots.txt, sitemap.xml and assets/ are published without being pages and are deliberately absent.
//apexHostname: The hostname the Worker serves. Named expectedCname until 2026-08-26, when the CNAME file it referred to went away with GitHub Pages.
//expectCustomDomain: true since the cutover. This and the custom_domain route in wrangler.jsonc are the same decision, and the gate fails on one without the other. See docs/runbooks/2026-08-12-pages-to-workers-cutover.md.
//title: The pull request title becomes the commit subject on main, because this repo squash-merges one PR per slice. tools/check/title.mjs holds it to conventional commits; these are the types this workspace uses.
//alwaysIgnored: Paths that are never in git but are always in the working directory wrangler uploads. The published set is derived from tracked files, so nothing else in this gate can see them; each must be named in .assetsignore explicitly.
